title: ContextUpdate
description: Frontmatter of context-updates/CU-YYYY-NNNN/update.md. Mirrors what server/src/services/contextUpdateService.ts reads and writes; /gtd-context-analyze and /gtd-context-apply refer to this file. The body holds the executive's notes for the analysis.

id.description: Also the draft file name: proposals/<id>.md holds the full proposed content of the target (not for remove).

action.description: remove: the dashboard moves the target to the trash once the update is done (a context note with its folder). Remove proposals have no draft and the apply step does not touch them. Never in a Kaizen.

target.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to create or update. The agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) and outputs/templates/<slug>/output.md only in a Kaizen (kind: kaizen).

category.description: Context category, or people, groups or org-charts.

rationale.description: Why the change matters for future work, and what differs from the current file.

evidence.description: Where the fact appears in the materials, e.g. a file and timestamp or slide number.

decision.description: Set by the executive in the dashboard, never by the analysis.

reviewer_note.description: The executive's instruction for the apply step, e.g. 'keep the old title'.

ref.description: A stakeholder id, or me. Only when the agent is sure.

name.description: The name as the material writes it, never translated.

meeting_date.description: When the meeting happened, if the material says.

speakers.description: Who each voice of a transcript may be: a proposal until the executive confirms the record.

source.description: The transcript the label belongs to.

reason.description: What in the transcript points to this person.

task_ref.description: Set by the dashboard: the task the executive created from this item. Not part of what was confirmed.

source.description: Where the record comes from, e.g. the material file.

confirmation.description: Set by the executive in the dashboard, never by the analysis.

confirmed_hash.description: Set by the dashboard: the record content the executive confirmed. If the record changes, the confirmation no longer counts.

origin.description: Who opened the update. Set by the dashboard only: system-cleanup for the weekly memory review, meetings for a meeting digest, kaizen for a Kaizen note. Absent for material the executive imported. Never set or change it.

kind.description: memory-review: no new material; review the existing context and stakeholders. daily-digest: meetings from the meeting queue, listed in materials/meetings.md; one meeting record per meeting (see the analyze command). kaizen: a task needed rework; materials/kaizen-note.md and the fields below hold the root cause, and proposals may also change the agent instruction files and output templates. Set by the dashboard only.

kaizen_note.description: Kaizen only: the kaizen/ note it was opened from. Set by the dashboard; never change it.

task_ref.description: Kaizen only: the task whose rework triggered it. Set by the dashboard; never change it.

symptom.description: Kaizen only: what went wrong in the task. Set by the dashboard; never change it.

root_cause.description: Kaizen only: what instruction or signal was missing. Set by the dashboard; never change it.

area.description: Kaizen only: optional grouping, e.g. instructions, templates. Set by the dashboard; never change it.

digest_meetings.description: Meeting digest only: which queued meeting each file came from. Written by the dashboard; never set or change it.

status.description: ready (material saved) > analyzing (agent) > in_review (executive) > approved > applying (agent) > done.

source_date.description: The date the material is from, not the upload date.

summary.description: What the material is and what changes, in two to four sentences.

materials.description: Kept by the dashboard. Stays as the record after the files themselves are deleted (or while keep_materials holds them).

keep_materials.description: Set by the executive in the dashboard, never by an agent. When true, the apply step and closing keep materials/; only the executive releases it.

meeting_records.description: One reviewed account per meeting in the material: drafted by the analysis, confirmed or rejected by the executive apart from the proposals. A confirmed record keeps the update out of System cleanup.

skipped.description: What the analysis considered and did not propose, so the executive can trust the filter.
